definitions.gloss: marginal note; note in the side margin
definitions.explanation: An annotation placed in the side margin, beside the main text. Used to gloss individual words or explain the passage running alongside it, especially in annotated editions and textbooks.

examples.japanese: {傍注|ぼうちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{傍注|ぼうちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傍注|ぼうちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼り：14634_tayori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{原文|げんぶん}→原文：20563_genbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: Relying on the textbook's marginal notes, I worked my way through the original text.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {傍|ぼう} (side, beside) + ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (note, annotation). Literally "a note at the side."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{脚注|きゃくちゅう}→脚注：06423_kyakuchuu⟧: footnote — a note at the foot of the page
- ⟦{頭注|とうちゅう}→頭注：29709_touchuu⟧: headnote — a note in the top margin
- ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧: annotation, commentary — the general term
